units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 25a:7">Kidd. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אף הס׳</he> castration of a slave also entitles him to his liberty.

ib. V, 3), נוטל ג׳ נחילין בס׳ he takes three broods of bees not in immediate succession of their birth, i.e. the first, the third and the fifth brood.—Pl. סֵירוּסִים, סֵירוּסִין, סֵר׳ (adv.) out of order, irregularly.

<cite ref="Megillah 18a">Meg. 18ᵃ</cite>, sq.; Y. ib. II, beg. 73ᵃ <he>קראה … ס׳</he> if one read the M’gillah in deranged order (= <he>לְמִפְרֵעַ</he>); cmp. <cite ref="O00836"><he>סֵירוּג</he></cite>.
